Amateur Call Signs for FOI Request 13 Ju.contentsIndicative: header Value,Prefix,Suffix,Type,Status (CRLF, UTF-8/ASCII); 135,866 data rows (verified by line count) - 85,672 Allocated, 50,164 Reserved, 30 Available, no blank statuses. Type is 'Call Sign - Amateur' throughout (service discriminator). Carries Ofcom's OWN prefix/suffix decomposition of each callsign, which is not uniformly three-letter-suffix-shaped (GM6JYC -> G6/JYC yet GM0SXQ -> GM/0SXQ) - preserved verbatim here, required-present-not-carried in the normalised projection. Anomalies preserved: one row has a blank callsign (blank Value/Prefix/Suffix) with a Reserved status; twelve six-, four seven- and seven eight-character callsigns (regional-locator and reciprocal M/... forms); 'G6 FMU' carries an interior space. Provenance: obtained by following a web link supplied with the July-2017 FOI response (mtime 2019-08-09); no public URL for these exact bytes, so no witness is asserted.
